title: OperationTipFor26w14a
body:
![showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b546d0a02071d9e4555226e2ca777dbf18716f7.png)  
Add operation tip in 26w14a.  
为26w14a快照添加操作提示。


Currently, it supports English and Simplified Chinese, and the mod has also supplemented the missing Chinese translations from the original version.  
目前，支持英语和简体中文，模组同时补齐了原版缺失的中文翻译。
